Kwenta is a decentralized derivatives trading platform. Kwenta is built on the Synthetix protocol. Kwenta runs on the Optimism layer-2 network built on Ethereum.

Hegic is a decentralized options protocol. Hegic operates on the Ethereum blockchain. Hegic uses liquidity pools from which option payouts are funded.

Drift is a decentralized perpetual futures exchange. Drift operates on the Solana blockchain.
